name: Retirement Relief in Quitting Service for the Construction Workers
nodalDept: BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, U.T. Administration of DNH & DD
briefDescription: This welfare scheme provides a certain amount to eligible registered construction workers in Dadra Nagar Haveli and Daman Diu upon quitting service after attaining age 60.
descriptionMd: The 'Retirement Relief in Quitting Service for the Construction Workers' is a crucial welfare scheme implemented by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, U.T. Administration of DNH & DD. It aims to provide essential financial support to registered construction workers as they transition out of active service. This initiative recognizes their years of contribution and offers a certain amount to ensure some level of financial security upon their retirement.
benefitsMd:
*   Provides a certain amount as retirement relief.
*   Supports registered construction workers upon quitting service.
*   Aims to enhance the welfare and financial security of workers post-retirement.
eligibilityMd:
*   Must be an eligible registered construction worker.
*   Must be quitting service.
*   Must have attained the age of 60 years.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
